remaining.problem: Observed: the successful Saved message uses the same red-bordered alert styling as the synthetic conflict. Hypothesis: Leon could interpret a successful save as a failure and retry unnecessarily.
remaining.suggestion: Use a distinct success presentation and a polite status region for successful saves; reserve alert/error styling for failures.

remaining.screen: Sections: after saving a completed document
remaining.problem: Observed: after-edits-laptop.png still shows PDF compiled and baseline origin while the first section says Saved. Review and rebuild PDF. Code changes the job to ready_for_review and section origin to user but inline save does not refresh those labels. Hypothesis: Leon may assume the existing PDF already contains his correction.
remaining.suggestion: After inline save, update the affected origin/edited marker and document status or show a prominent stale-PDF notice with a direct review-and-rebuild link.

remaining.problem: Observed: the editor says generated tables are preserved but does not display their contents. Hypothesis: Leon cannot verify that architecture prose remains consistent with the retained tables without leaving the editor.
remaining.suggestion: Provide a read-only table preview alongside the prose editor or a clearly labeled preview link that respects unsaved changes.
